}}'''Moad din Nopara Red Hawk''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'', and the [[Swordmaster]] to [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Moad din Nopara Red Hawk}}

== Appearance ==
He has gray hair and hard eyes. He is more white-haired than Harine. He is 5'10" or 178&nbsp;cm tall. He has five rings in each ear.

In Far Madding, he wears a quilted blue coat that he uses to protect him while sailing the coldest seas.{{Ref/book|9|23}}

He wears an sword in his belt and a dagger in his sash, both with an ivory hilt, as signs of his office as Swordmaster.{{Ref/book|9|35}} Also a mark of rank, he uses a two-tiered red-fringed parasol.{{ref/book|6|5}} When Rand is on the [[White Spray]], he wears baggy trousers of green silk. {{Ref/book|7|34}}

== History ==
He is a widower.{{Ref/book|9|23}}

[[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]] is surprised that he knows how to ride a horse, an uncommon skill among the Atha'an Miere.

Harine gives him so much leeway as Swordmaster that anyone who didn't know would have thought them lovers.

== Activities ==
Mat spies Harine and Moad on the deck of their ship as it heads down the [[River Alguenya]] towards [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]].{{Ref/book|6|5}}

He is present when Harine receives Rand as the [[Coramoor]] aboard the [[White Spray]] in Cairhien, although he is not present during the Bargain.{{Ref/book|7|34}} 

He accompanies [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and Harine to [[Far Madding]] to find [[Rand al'Thor]]. On entering the city, he is hesitant to hand over his sword to be peace-bonded as it is a sign of his office.{{Ref/book|9|23}} As a man, it is not considered appropriate that he enter the [[Hall of the Counsels]] and so he is left behind when Harine is received by the Counsels.{{Ref/book|9|24}}
 
After leaving Far Madding, he stands guard over [[Min Farshaw]] and Harine during the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]].{{Ref/book|9|35}}
